I was born and raised in a small town in the Midwest. My parents were hardworking individuals who instilled in me the value of a strong work ethic from a young age. I have two younger siblings, and we were very close growing up. We spent our summers exploring the great outdoors and our winters building snowmen and having snowball fights.

As a child, I was always curious about the world around me. I would ask my parents countless questions about everything from animals to space exploration. They encouraged my curiosity and enrolled me in various extracurricular activities, including science camp and art classes. These experiences helped shape my love for learning and sparked my passion for creativity.

When it came time to choose a college, I knew I wanted to attend a school that would challenge me academically while also providing opportunities for growth and exploration. I decided to attend a liberal arts college on the East Coast, where I studied psychology and fine arts. During my time in college, I became involved in several clubs and organizations, including the psychology club and the art honors society. I also had the opportunity to study abroad in Europe, where I was able to immerse myself in different cultures and broaden my horizons.

After graduation, I moved to a large city and began working at a mental health clinic. I worked with patients suffering from anxiety and depression, using various therapeutic techniques to help them manage their symptoms. While I enjoyed the challenging nature of my work, I felt something was missing. I longed for a more creative outlet.

I eventually made the decision to pursue a career in graphic design. I enrolled in a graduate program at a local university and began taking courses in typography, branding, and web design. I quickly discovered a natural talent for design and found that I could combine my love for creativity with my desire to help others.

Today, I work as a freelance graphic designer, specializing in branding and marketing materials for small businesses. I have had the opportunity to work with clients from all over the world, and I enjoy the freedom and flexibility that comes with being my own boss. In my free time, I continue to explore my creative interests, experimenting with different mediums and techniques.

Throughout my life, I have been fortunate enough to have had many incredible experiences and opportunities. I have learned that with hard work and dedication, anything is possible. I am grateful for the support of my family and friends, who have encouraged me every step of the way. As I continue to grow and evolve both personally and professionally, I know that there will be many exciting adventures ahead.
